content: During pregnancy, precise insulin titration and frequent blood glucose monitoring are essential. Therefore, it is strongly recommended to refer patients to a specialized multidisciplinary team. This team should include endocrinologists, maternal-fetal medicine experts, and diabetes care specialists to ensure optimal management. The use of advanced technologies, such as automated insulin delivery (AID) systems and predictive low-glucose suspend (PLGS) technology, may provide additional benefits for certain patients. These technologies can be particularly helpful in managing hypoglycemia and achieving targeted glucose levels effectively.
